value.title: Control a window
value.description: Control this connected instance. target defaults to main; player means the detached player. fullscreen/always_on_top/pip/detached require enabled:true/false. pip/detached require target:player; enabling detaches the same Classic player without restarting playback. Disabling pip leaves it detached; disabling detached returns it to main. fit_video requires main/player and an internal video. show focuses/restores main/player or creates external_controls/external_list for an active external session. close main hides it (the process and endpoint remain alive); close player returns playback to main; close external_controls also closes its list, retaining external playback. tray requires main and uses Classic tray/taskbar handling. Use app.quit to end the instance. No confirmation parameters.
